Upon reaching 20 stacks, the next hit consumes all stacks to deal extra True Damage based on the number of stacks. When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15s) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

passiveencourage.name: Passive - Encourage
passiveencourage.desc: Passive: Grants you and nearby allied heroes 20 extra Hybrid Defense. When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15s) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

passivefavor.name: Passive - Favor
passivefavor.desc: Passive: Every 15s, your next healing or shield skill recovers 400 extra HP to the lowest-HP allied hero within 5 units (including yourself). Skills that only take effect on yourself cannot trigger this effect. When near allied heroes, you gain 30% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps. Dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15s) or revealing enemies also grants EXP and Gold. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving.

powerpotion.name: Power Potion
powerpotion.desc: Unique Passive - Increase Power: Upon purchase. grants 30 Physical Attack and 15% Lifesteal for 120s.

queenswings.name: Queen's Wings
queenswings.desc: Unique Passive - Demonize: When HP drops below 40%, gains 30% Damage Reduction for 3 seconds and reduces skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. This effect has a 60s cooldown. Unique Passive - Defiance: For every 1% HP lost, damage is increased by 0.25%, up to 15%.

radiantarmor.name: Radiant Armor
radiantarmor.desc: Unique Passive - Holy Blessing: Taking Magic Damage grants 5(+1*Hero Level) Magic Defense for 5 seconds, up to 6 stacks (can only gain 1 stack(s) every 0.4 seconds).

rapidboots.name: Rapid Boots
rapidboots.desc: Attributes: +55 Movement Speed. The fastest boots, for roamers who need to rotate.

rockpotion.desc: Unique Passive - Increase power: Upon purchase, grants 500 Max HP and 5% Damage Reduction for 120s.

rosegoldmeteor.name: Rose Gold Meteor
rosegoldmeteor.desc: Unique Passive - Dragon Scale: Every 4 extra Physical Attack increases Hybrid Defense by 1, up to 50 (effect is halved if Main Role is not Fighter). Unique Passive - Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (120*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60s cooldown.

seahalberd.name: Sea Halberd
seahalberd.desc: Unique Passive - Lifebane: Dealing damage to a target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds. Unique Passive - Punish: Increase damage by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.

skypiercer.name: Sky Piercer
skypiercer.desc: Unique Passive - Lethality: After dealing damage to an enemy hero, executes the hero if their HP is lower than 4%. Gains 10 stack(s) of Lethality for each kill and loses 30% current stack(s) for each death. Each stack of Lethality increases the HP threshold of the execute effect by 0.1%, stacking up 80 times.

starliumscythe.name: Starlium Scythe
starliumscythe.desc: Unique Passive - Crisis: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 90 (+60% Total Magic Power) extra True Damage and reduces the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 1.5 seconds (1.5 seconds cooldown).

throwforbidden.name: Throw Forbidden
throwforbidden.desc: Unique Passive - Heavy Mountain: Become immune to allied Jawhead's Ejector in this match.

thunderbelt.desc: Unique Passive - Thunderbolt: Every 4 seconds, the next Basic Attack deals 50 (+100% Extra Physical Defense) (+100% Extra Magic Defense) extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them, and briefly slows them by 99%. windofnature.desc: Active Skill - Wind Chant: Become immune to all Physical Damage for 2 seconds (duration is halved for non-Marksmen; 90 seconds cooldown).

windtalker.name: Windtalker
windtalker.desc: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5–2 seconds (reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150–362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

wintercrown.name: Winter Crown
wintercrown.desc: Active Skill - Frozen: Becomes frozen, untargetable, and immune to damage for 2 seconds (100 seconds cooldown). Cannot move or cast skills while frozen, but skills already cast won't be interrupted.

wishinglantern.name: Wishing Lantern
wishinglantern.desc: Unique Passive - Butterfly Goddess: For every 800 Magic Damage dealt to an enemy hero (calculated before Damage Reduction), a Butterfly Goddess is summoned to attack the enemy hero, dealing Magic Damage equal to 8% of their Current HP.
